messages:
paul: Heads-up: cross-service rollout tonight 01:00-02:00 UTC. Sequence: runtime 2.7.0 -> api 1.12.0 -> router 4.5. Console migration behind FF. Any blockers?
keisha: No blockers from infra, but console needs the api header flip (x-rdwd-new) gated. We should keep console FF off until router confirms passthrough.
tom: Agreed. Proposed pins: pin runtime first, then api, then router. If runtime rolls back, unpin api/router immediately.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime@2.7.0, api@1.12.0[ff:header_new], router@4.5. Start 01:00 UTC. Preflight running. :robot_face:
ops: Preflight: capacity OK. Staging smoke passed except a minor header-dup warning handled in 1.12.0. We'll seed dashboards.
paul: Canary plan: runtime quick 5% 5m, api 5% 10m behind FF, then 25% 10m, then router. Halt if api/router 5xx >1.5% or p95 +200ms for two windows.
keisha: Add console signal: console/schema-errors >0.5% => kill FF and hold migration. Also add api.header.normalize.warn >30/min alert.
anna: Rollback snippets to paste:
```
# rollback api
deploy-bot rollback api@1.12.0 -> api@1.11.5
# rollback runtime
kubectl -n runtime set image deploy/runtime runtime:2.6.9
# unpin sequence
deploy-bot unpin api
deploy-bot unpin router
```
tom: Post-deploy hook will run schema-check then e2e-smoke; if schema-check fails deploy-bot will auto-queue rollback.
deploy-bot: preflight OK: images signed, smoke tests passed for runtime+api, router smoke queued.
paul: I'll be lead for rollback call. Keisha owns infra signals. Ops watch to post minute-by-minute. Kicking at 01:00.
ops: Oncall set: ops (primary), anna (secondary). Posting dashboards now.
paul: Thanks all. Keep this thread as single source for rollback commands and decisions.
